newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: RESEARCH ALERT - DBS upgrades Comfort.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - DBS upgrades Comfort.

text.p: DBS Investment Research said on Thursday it had upgraded its recommendation for Comfort Group Ltd from hold to accumulate.
DBS said in a statement that the medium to long-term prospects for taxi operator Comfort were positive and current valuations attractive.

"A hike in taxi daily rental nest year would render Comfort shares more appealing as we estimate that for every dollar increase, (earnings per share) would improve by about 0.4 cent," the statement said. Comfort shares were at Singapore $1.26 at midday on Thursday. -- Singapore newsroom 65-8703080
